name: @discord-meeting/repository
description: Summary-first Discord AI Meeting Assistant built around an isolated Craig voice gateway.

scripts.check: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run post-call:e2e && pnpm run python:check && pnpm run conversation:e2e && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run foundation:check && pnpm run architecture:patterns && pnpm run architecture:patterns:test && pnpm run dead-code:check && pnpm run nx:projects
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run lint:fast && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run foundation:check && pnpm run architecture:patterns && pnpm run architecture:patterns:test && pnpm run nx:projects
scripts.coverage: pnpm run coverage:typescript && pnpm run coverage:node && pnpm run coverage:python && pnpm run coverage:normalize
scripts.coverage:node: cd infra/subscription-runtime && mkdir -p coverage && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='*.mjs' --test-coverage-exclude='test/**' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info test/*.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:normalize: for report in apps/meeting-platform/coverage/lcov.info apps/subscription-runtime-sidecar/coverage/lcov.info packages/*/coverage/lcov.info; do prefix=${report%/coverage/lcov.info}; perl -pi -e "s{^SF:src/}{SF:$prefix/src/}" "$report"; done && perl -pi -e 's{^SF:(?!infra/subscription-runtime/)}{SF:infra/subscription-runtime/}' infra/subscription-runtime/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.coverage:typescript: node vendor/infinity-context/prepare-official-sdk.mjs && pnpm --recursive --if-present run build && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --recursive --filter './apps/**' --filter './packages/**' --filter '!@discord-meeting/discord-e2e-actors' --filter '!@discord-meeting/infinity-context-adapter' --filter '!@discord-meeting/meeting-core' --filter '!@discord-meeting/meeting-platform' --filter '!@discord-meeting/recording-ingress-adapter' exec vitest run --coverage --coverage.include='src/**' --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary --exclude='**/*.e2e.test.ts' --exclude='**/*.integration.test.ts' --exclude='**/postgres-diagnostic-final-evidence.test.ts' --exclude='**/voicetext-gateway-deployment.test.ts' && pnpm --filter @discord-meeting/meeting-core exec vitest run --coverage --coverage.include='dist/**/*.js' --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary && pnpm --filter @discord-meeting/recording-ingress-adapter exec vitest run test/ogg-opus.test.ts --coverage --coverage.include='src/**' --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary && pnpm --filter @discord-meeting/meeting-platform exec vitest run test/health.test.ts test/secret-file-reader.test.ts test/transcript-outline-summary-adapter.test.ts --coverage --coverage.include='src/**' --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary && pnpm --filter @discord-meeting/infinity-context-adapter exec vitest run test/hmac-historical-ids.test.ts test/infinity-embedding-input.test.ts --coverage --coverage.include='src/**' --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=text-summary
scripts.foundation:check: pnpm run architecture:protobuf && pnpm run architecture:meeting-core-imports && agent-teams-foundation check && pnpm run foundation:assert-dev-only && pnpm run foundation:assert-registry
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:fast && pnpm run lint:type-aware
scripts.python:check: pnpm run python:sync && cd apps/pipecat-runtime && uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright && uv run lint-imports && uv run python tools/check_no_suppressions.py && uv run pytest
scripts.workspace:check: pnpm --filter=@discord-meeting/infinity-context-adapter... --if-present run build && pnpm --filter=@discord-meeting/infinity-context-adapter run check && pnpm --filter=!@discord-meeting/infinity-context-adapter --recursive --if-present run check
